title: The Presidential Succession
description: The Assembly has accepted your accountability speech. Choose a candidate to lead your campaign for the presidency through 2004. Three political challenges stand between you and the MPR's vote.
overwhelmingVictoryMessage: Your overwhelming victory secures your mandate through 2004. No further presidential election is held during this stage.
characterPrompt: Choose the candidate you will lead through the presidential election.
electionDescription: The 700 MPR delegates cast their votes to decide who will serve as President until 2004. Your campaign's support among each faction determines its chance of voting for your candidate.

candidates.name: Bacharuddin Jusuf Habibie
candidates.description: Placeholder biography: PDI-P's leader and the leading voice of the nationalist opposition.

candidates.name: Megawati Sukarnoputri
candidates.description: Placeholder biography: PDI-P's leader and the leading voice of the nationalist opposition.

candidates.name: Amien Rais
candidates.description: Placeholder biography: PAN's chairman and a central organizer of the Islamic-oriented Central Axis coalition.

candidates.name: Abdurrahman Wahid (Gus Dur)
candidates.description: Placeholder biography: Nahdlatul Ulama leader and a potential consensus candidate. Portrait placeholder until an image is added.

candidates.name: Wiranto
candidates.description: Placeholder biography: ABRI's commander, available only if the military has distanced itself from Habibie and both military reforms remain unenacted.

events.title: The Coalition Question
events.description: Your candidate must persuade a divided Assembly that a new presidency can hold the republic together. How will the campaign open?

options.reaction: Party leaders welcome the promise, while asking how cabinet posts will be divided.

options.text: Put reform and civil liberties first.
options.reaction: Reform groups applaud the pledge, but some establishment delegates remain wary.

events.title: The Cabinet Question
events.description: Delegates want to know who will hold the key ministries in the next government. What does your candidate offer?

options.text: Share cabinet responsibilities across the major blocs.
options.reaction: The coalition talks gain momentum, though each bloc expects a meaningful role.

options.text: Keep the cabinet compact and focused on reform.
options.reaction: The reform pledge energizes civil society delegates, but party bosses ask for guarantees.

events.title: The Final Appeal
events.description: The MPR is preparing to vote. Your candidate has one final opportunity to win over undecided delegates.

options.text: Make a personal appeal for unity and constitutional stability.
options.reaction: The final appeal is delivered. Delegates take their seats for the presidential ballot.

options.text: Challenge the Assembly to honor the voters' reform mandate.
options.reaction: KOMPAS: The final appeal is delivered. Delegates take their seats for the presidential ballot.
